definition: the four scarred domains that returned in a cluster, and the one that stayed buried

settled:
Four domains I once had to quit outright have come back: ESO, coding, AI storytelling, image generation. The same trajectory four times. Quit at the scar, safety climbed, the want crossed, the runs wore the scar away.

They came back clustered rather than one at a time.

Hand-making did not come with them. It stayed buried while the rest returned, untouched by eighteen months of recovery.

Image generation is art through a screen, which is why I was asked whether some of the price of hand-making might already be wearing down where my gate cannot see it.

What I said: it is possible a component is being paid down already, and I hope that is true. It is definitely a different modality, but it feels like there should be overlap there.

I hold that as hope rather than fact.

title: What Came Back Together And What Did Not
